name: Pentamaster Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年，Pentamaster Corporation Berhad 提出以现金 RM10.00 向持股71.0%的子公司 Pentamaster International Limited 收购 Pentamaster Mediq Sdn. Bhd. 及 Mirak Medica Sdn. Bhd. 的全部股权，其他业务线在公告中未见扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Pentamaster Corporation Berhad proposed to acquire 100% equity interest in Pentamaster Mediq Sdn. Bhd. and Mirak Medica Sdn. Bhd. from its 71.0%-owned subsidiary Pentamaster International Limited for a cash consideration of RM10.00, bringing the medical business line under direct ownership of the listed company. No expansion, reduction, or contract updates were announced for the other business lines.
